response.query: Which capacity-constrained allocation and queuing approaches (iterative gravity with exp(-β·t), capacity caps, M/M/s, Monte Carlo simulations) best estimate shelter overflow and waiting times under peak heat?
response.answer: For shelter overflow and waiting times under peak heat, M/M/s and Monte Carlo simulations are most effective. Iterative gravity with exp(-β·t) and capacity caps are less suitable for dynamic conditions.
